# Ironbark Press - pressroom workspace

Shared folder for the prepress desk.

- press/  imposition cards for the runs
- stock/  paper delivery notes

turns.prompt: A prepress hand at Ironbark Press asked what an imposition sheet means for a press run; one sheet carries several pages on each face, it is printed on both faces, and every page of the programme appears once. The Dunsmere run uses 840 sheets with 8 pages on each face. Give the number of finished pages the run produces.
